prompts.prompt: A vibrant Diwali festival poster for an Indian sweet shop, vertical 9:16 format for Instagram/WhatsApp status. Warm golden-hour lighting, rich reds, maroons, and gold festive color palette with diyas (oil lamps), marigold flowers, rangoli patterns, and soft bokeh fairy lights in the background. In the center foreground, an elegant traditional silver/brass thali (tray) piled high with freshly cut, glistening kaju katli (diamond-shaped cashew sweets) with a delicate edible silver leaf (chandi vark) shine, arranged neatly to look moist, soft, and freshly made — no wrappers, no packaging, just the sweets styled beautifully. Sprinkle a few rose petals, pistachio slivers, and a lit diya beside the tray for festive warmth. At the top of the poster, large bold elegant Hindi typography reading exactly 'दिवाली धमाका' in a golden festive font with a subtle glow/foil effect. Directly below it, in a clean bold banner or ribbon style, the English text exactly as written: '1 kg kaju katli pe 250 g FREE' in a contrasting gold or white font that pops against the red/maroon background. At the bottom of the poster, elegant smaller text: 'Shree Ganesh Sweets' as the shop name in a premium serif/traditional font, with 'Johari Bazaar, Jaipur' beneath it in a smaller subtext line. Add subtle diya and firecracker/sparkle illustrations along the borders as decorative festive elements. Overall mood: premium, mouth-watering, festive, high-end mithai shop advertisement, clean layout with clear text hierarchy, no human figures, no product photography — fully illustrated/rendered poster art with sharp focus on the sweets looking fresh, moist, and appetizing.

notes: Only one still is needed (no video/film was requested). Riskiest element within this single image: getting the exact Hindi text 'दिवाली धमाका' and the English offer line 'रु1 kg kaju katli pe 250 g FREE' to render correctly without spelling/rendering glitches — AI image models often mangle Devanagari script and exact text strings. Recommend generating 2-3 variations and checking text accuracy carefully, or overlaying the text manually in an editor post-generation if the model garbles it. Since no reference photos of the shop's actual product were provided, the kaju katli styling is generic 'stock premium mithai' look — if the customer wants their specific recipe/shape/packaging reflected, request 1-2 real photos of their kaju katli next time for a Nano Banana 2 edit-with-reference workflow instead.
